parsed.name: USB4000/USB2000+光谱仪
parsed.description: Ocean Insight 的 USB4000/USB2000+ 系列光谱仪，用于实验室中的光谱采集与光学信号测量。该设备通过 USB 通信，可读取光谱数据、设置积分时间，并查询采集请求与光谱就绪状态，适用于吸收、发射或一般光谱分析实验。
parsed.description_en: An Ocean Insight USB4000/USB2000+ series spectrometer for laboratory spectral acquisition and optical signal measurement. It communicates over USB, can read spectral data, set integration time, and report acquisition-request and spectrum-ready states for absorption, emission, or general spectroscopy workflows.

actions.description: 初始化光谱仪设备并建立 USB 通信。

actions.description: 设置光谱采集的积分时间（毫秒）。
actions.description_en: Set the integration time for spectral acquisition in milliseconds.

actions.description_en: Check whether a spectrum acquisition has been requested and the device is still waiting for completion.
